description: The Plasmasphere model estimates evolving particle densities and plasmapause position through a kinetic representation. Its geometry and trapped-particle assumptions support studies of the near-Earth plasma environment. The resource is documented by Royal Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy. The documented physical domain is Geospace, Magnetosphere / Inner Magnetosphere / Plasmasphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Runs-on-Request. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. It shares a principal publication and developer lineage with BSPM, but the pages document different configurations; a shared citation alone does not establish duplication. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
